---
title: "05 · Fully optimized geometry"
order: 5
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

A 300 mm span glider cut from 3 mm foam where almost all geometry (sweep, dihedral, tail area, boom length, tail incidence) is optimized for minimum sink rate in trimmed glide. Adds stability constraints: 10% minimum static margin, plus lateral and directional stability.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified

Asked of the user, 2026-09-16:

1. **Minimum static margin**: 10%, to size the tail.
2. **Span**: 300 mm, fixed tip to tip.
3. **Objective**: minimum sink rate in trimmed glide.
4. **Foam thickness**: 3 mm.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **Directional and lateral stability bounds**: `0.0005`, for IPOPT.
2. **Foam density**: scaled linearly from 5 mm foam.
3. **Airfoil thickness**: 3% to match foam.
:::
